title: Topic 3.5: Raising Lazarus from the Dead

pages.lesson:
LESSON: RAISING LAZARUS FROM THE DEAD

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.5: Raising Lazarus from the Dead
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Raising Lazarus from the Dead, part of The Life of Jesus Christ in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why did Jesus say that Lazarus was only asleep?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Raising Lazarus from the Dead in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. outline lessons learnt from the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Raising Lazarus from the Dead in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate God’s power over sickness and death.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Raising Lazarus from the Dead in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. describe the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead,

   Raising Lazarus from the Dead helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. outline lessons learnt from the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead,

   Raising Lazarus from the Dead helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate God’s power over sickness and death.

   Raising Lazarus from the Dead helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Raising Lazarus from the Dead together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: the skill of reflection on own learning is enhanced as learners share experiences of how they show

empathy to others.

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of originality is enhanced as learners compose a poem on ‘God’s power over

sickness and death’.

26

Values:
• Love is portrayed as they learn to grieve with those who have lost loved ones.

• Respect is inculcated as they learn to value human dignity as portrayed by Jesus Christ when He raised Lazarus from the

dead.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion: is enhanced as learners show empathy to those who have lost their loved ones.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Social Studies skills are enhanced as learners discuss how to show empathy to those who have lost loved ones.

Main points to remember:

1. describe the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead,
2. outline lessons learnt from the miracle of raising Lazarus from the dead,
3. appreciate God’s power over sickness and death.

Remember the key question: Why did Jesus say that Lazarus was only asleep?
